name: io.github.kimgh06/thask
description: Dependency-graph layer for AI-assisted development. Lets Claude Code / Cursor / Codex query 'what breaks if I change this?' against a structured graph of your codebase, with provenance guards that block agents from silently landing hallucinated descriptions.

environmentVariables.name: THASK_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Thask server (e.g. https://thask.kimgh06.com or http://localhost:7244). Can also be set via `thask config set url <url>`.

environmentVariables.name: THASK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key for your Thask account. Generate via `thask login` (browser flow, recommended) or in the web UI settings.
